question: Which of the following Carnatic musicians was the first to receive the Bharat Ratna?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Subbulakshmi**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi** was the first Carnatic musician to receive the Bharat Ratna, India's highest civilian award.
 
• She was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 1998 for her exceptional contribution to Carnatic music.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi is renowned for her melodious voice and her ability to bring classical music to a global audience.
 
• Her performances and recordings have left an indelible mark on Indian classical music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **MS Subbulakshmi** was born on September 16, 1916, in Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
 
• She was also the first Indian musician to receive the Ramon Magsaysay award, often considered Asia's Nobel Prize, in 1974.
 
• She performed at prestigious venues worldwide, including the United Nations General Assembly in 1966.
 
• MS Subbulakshmi's legacy continues to inspire generations of musicians and music lovers.
